description: Git bulk ops — investigation + workflow combos in one call

git-status.description: Branch, commits, changes, stashes, open MR/PR

git-investigate.description: File history: commits, uncommitted, blame hotspots

git-blame.description: Git blame N lines around LINE

git-checkout.description: Switch to REF — branch, tracking, dirty, last commits

git-diverge.description: Branch vs base — ahead/behind, commits, files, +/- totals

git-merge.description: Merge REF — on conflict: UU files, markers, ours/theirs SHAs

git-conflicts.description: List UU files + every conflict block + abort hint

git-resolve.description: Pick ours/theirs for PATH (or all) + stage + continue cmd

git-commit.description: Commit MSG (stages PATHS) — HEAD before/after, hook errors surfaced
